statement: ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ n p : ℕ, B < n ∧ Nat.Prime p ∧ p ∣ n ^ 2 + 1 ∧ n ^ 1 < p ^ 1

plain_statement.zh: 对任意自然数 B，存在 n > B，使 n² + 1 有一个大于 n 的素因子。
plain_statement.en: For every natural number B there is an n > B such that n² + 1 has a prime divisor greater than n.

brief.zh: 取 m = (B² + 1)! 并选取 m² + 1 的一个素因子 p。用 n = m mod p 证明 B < n < p。
brief.en: Take m = (B² + 1)! and a prime divisor p of m² + 1. Set n = m mod p and show B < n < p.
